message.content:
Critics of Nicolaus Copernicus included Andreas Cestodorus, Tycho Brahe, and Christopher Clavius.  
They challenged his claim that the Earth moves around the Sun.  
Why did they oppose him?  
Did his mathematics seem too radical?  
The debate was fierce!  
His model changed science!
